name: Arizona
subtitle: Zone offense: swing it, bigs work the triangle, overload
goal: Move the zone with the pass while the bigs keep filling the open spot in the lane, then overload one side.
options: Best: a big flashing into the spot the other one just left. After the reversal: 2 in the corner, 5 at the elbow, or 4 on the block.

steps.note: 1 passes to 2. 5 cuts across the lane to the open block on the ball side.
4 dives to the block 5 just left. The bigs work a triangle: the two blocks and the middle of the free throw line. Always fill the spot your teammate just left.
Reverse it: 2 passes back to 1. 5 flashes up to the middle of the free throw line, the spot 4 just left.
1 swings it to 3. 5 slides to the ball-side elbow, and 2 bends along the baseline to the opposite corner.
Overload: 3 has 2 in the corner, 5 at the elbow and 4 on the block. Find the open one.
